title: USG-UC Keycloak voice configuration
description: Parameters for Configure-Voice.ps1. Deliberately contains NO credentials — auth is supplied via flags or env vars (KC_ADMIN_TOKEN, KC_SA_CLIENT_ID/_SECRET, KC_ADMIN_USER/_PASSWORD) so this file is safe to commit.

url.description: Base URL of the Keycloak instance, e.g. https://icam.oopl.dev.mil (http only for local dev)

realm.description: Target realm to configure. Must already exist.

authRealm.description: Realm the admin credential lives in (master for the global admin; the target realm for a realm-local admin)

sipDomain.description: SIP domain of user AORs; emitted as the hardcoded sip_domain claim, e.g. example.mil

softClientId.description: Client id of the public PKCE client the soft client uses for browser sign-in

provisioningClientId.description: Bearer-only client acting as the token audience for sbc-client-config-server

redirectUris.description: Allowed redirect URIs: desktop loopback (RFC 8252 §7.3) and/or Android claimed App Link

enableDeviceFlow.description: Enable the Device Authorization Grant on the soft client so Get-TestToken.ps1 can mint test tokens

testUser.description: Optional test account, created/updated with the sipDn attribute. Omit the whole section in production realms.

dn.description: Directory number stored in the sipDn user attribute

password.description: Test-only credential, set via reset-password. Never put a production credential here; prefer the -TestUserPassword flag or TEST_USER_PASSWORD env var to keep it out of the file.
